intro.fr: La version Legendary Edition de Mass Effect 2 a son randomizer, signé ME3Tweaks.
intro.en: The Legendary Edition of Mass Effect 2 has its randomizer, made by ME3Tweaks.

text.fr: BioWare sort Mass Effect Legendary Edition en 2021, qui réunit la trilogie remastérisée.
text.en: BioWare releases Mass Effect Legendary Edition in 2021, bringing together the remastered trilogy.

text.fr: Le 7 novembre 2023, ME3Tweaks publie sur Nexus Mods le Mass Effect 2 Legendary Edition Randomizer.
text.en: On November 7, 2023, ME3Tweaks posts the Mass Effect 2 Legendary Edition Randomizer on Nexus Mods.
